acceptance_criteria.demo_records_spawn_socket_configured_gue: restore.rs DemoPhase enumerates spawn/socket_ready/configured/guest_ready/snapshot_ready/restore_ready/request; PhaseLog records monotonic completion timestamps enforcing strictly-increasing rank (SnapshotReady and RestoreReady share a rank so a timeline contains exactly one) and non-decreasing time. The cold path records spawn->socket->configured->guest_ready->snapshot_ready->request; a warm restore records spawn->socket->configured->restore_ready->request. report.rs ColdPhaseDurations::from_logs derives socket_ready_ms/configured_ms/guest_ready_ms/snapshot_ready_ms/restore_ready_ms/request_ms (cumulative from t=0 via PhaseLog::elapsed_ms) and the report carries them in cold_phases. Tests: restore::cold_timeline_records_all_cold_phases, warm_timeline_skips_guest_boot, out_of_order_phase_is_rejected, snapshot_and_restore_are_mutually_exclusive, duplicate_phase_is_rejected, backwards_timestamp_is_rejected; snapshot_restore_protocol::demo_records_all_named_phase_durations; report::cold_phase_durations_derive_from_logs.
acceptance_criteria.N_ge_100_restore_trials_accounted_includ: runner.rs DemoRunner runs `samples` warm request trials and accounts for every one: warm.samples + warm.failures == request_trials == samples (ColdWarmMeasurement::trials_reconcile). Restore attempts (warmup fills + on-demand restores + no-snapshot attempts) are counted in restore_trials/restore_failures. With samples=100 the happy path records request_trials=100; the guest-never-ready path records restore_trials=100 and restore_failures=100 (every timed-out trial). Tests: runner::every_trial_is_accounted_for_invariant, happy_path_records_cold_and_warm, guest_never_ready_records_every_trial_as_failure; measure::all_failed_warm_has_zero_samples_but_records_failures, trials_reconcile_detects_mismatch; snapshot_restore_protocol::happy_path_accounts_for_every_restore_trial_and_cleans_up, guest_never_ready_records_all_timeouts_no_warm_and_cleanup.

Warm percentiles are computed by the microvm-bench harness (Distribution/Percentiles, nearest-rank). Tests: report_schema::completed_report_has_required_fields_and_no_pass_gate, committed_example_and_schema_are_consistent; runner::workload_pins_function_rootfs_hash; measure::cold_first_call_and_warm_percentiles_are_reported.
acceptance_criteria.no_benchmark_boolean_gate_is_emitted: There is no `pass` field at any nesting level and no method that reduces the measurements to a verdict. schemas/warm-http-demo.v1.json sets additionalProperties:false plus an explicit not:{required:['pass']}. DemoOutcome (Completed/Blocked) describes whether the demo RAN, not whether a latency target was met; cold_first_call_ms and the warm percentiles are metadata only. acceptance_criteria.snapshot_after_readiness_and_restore_thr: restore.rs VmRestorer is the orchestrator restore seam. cold_start probes the real handler (GET /health -> 200) for guest readiness and only then records SnapshotReady and produces the SnapshotArtifact (snapshot taken AFTER service readiness); restore loads a warm VM that reaches RestoreReady without re-running guest boot. ScriptedRestorer drives deterministic timings; LocalFunctionRestorer models the protocol in-process with real monotonic timing for the binary. Tests: restore::scripted_cold_start_snapshots_after_readiness, scripted_restore_builds_a_warm_vm, restore_before_cold_start_is_rejected, exhausted_restore_script_fails; local::local_cold_start_snapshots_after_readiness, local_restore_serves_a_warm_request; snapshot_restore_protocol::snapshot_is_taken_after_service_readiness, warm_restore_reaches_restore_ready_without_guest_boot.
acceptance_criteria.must_not_add_autoscaling_multi_function_: function.rs serves exactly one static Rust HttpFunction (pure request->response; GET /health readiness, GET / greeting, POST / echo, else 404) from one pinned content-addressed local Rootfs (SHA-256). pool.rs FunctionPool fills to a fixed target size and reuses VMs (no autoscaling); acquire/release cycle the same warm VMs. No second language runtime, no persistent external data, no routing to other functions. Tests: function_handler::only_one_function_no_routing_to_others, rootfs_is_pinned_and_local, invocation_is_deterministic; pool_management::pool_is_filled_to_a_fixed_size_no_autoscaling, acquire_release_reuses_warm_vms.

key_types.HttpFunction: function.rs: the single minimal static Rust HTTP function. Pure handle(&HttpRequest)->HttpResponse: GET /health -> 200 'ok' (readiness), GET / -> 200 greeting, POST / -> 200 echo, else 404. is_ready() recognises a successful /health response. Packaged in a pinned local Rootfs (name + SHA-256). No external state, no routing to other functions.
key_types.FunctionPool: pool.rs: a warm pool of pre-restored VMs. fill(restorer, snapshot, target) restores up to `target` VMs through the orchestrator, pooling successes (warmup_count) and counting failures (fill_failures) without pooling them; acquire/release reuse VMs; drain() cleans up. Fixed size — no autoscaling.
key_types.ColdWarmMeasurement: measure.rs: cold first-call vs warm request structure. cold_first_call_ms (Option), warm Distribution (reused microvm-bench harness: samples/failures/p50/p95/p99/min/max), request_trials, warmup_count, restore_trials, restore_failures. warm_p50/p95/p99 accessors; trials_reconcile() asserts warm.samples+warm.failures==request_trials. blocked() is empty with nulls (no fabrication).
key_types.DemoRunner: runner.rs: orchestrates the demo with blocked/completed outcomes. Probes the restorer (blocked -> blocked report, no fabrication); cold-starts (snapshot after readiness, cold first call); fills the warm pool and serves N warm requests recording successes/failures separately; cleans up every pooled VM and discards the snapshot. Produces a DemoReport with no pass/fail gate. DemoOutcome (Completed/Blocked) is an execution outcome, never a performance verdict.
key_types.VmRestorer: restore.rs: the orchestrator restore seam (async trait). probe()->LaneOutcome, cold_start(function)->ColdStart (snapshot+phases+first_call_ms), restore(snapshot)->RestoredVm. ScriptedRestorer drives deterministic tests (fixed phase timings via PhaseLog::from_deltas; blocked/guest-never-ready modes); LocalFunctionRestorer models the protocol in-process with real monotonic timing for the binary.
key_types.PhaseLog: restore.rs: ordered monotonic phase recorder for DemoPhase (spawn/socket_ready/configured/guest_ready/snapshot_ready/restore_ready/request). Enforces strictly-increasing rank (SnapshotReady and RestoreReady share a rank, so mutually exclusive) and non-decreasing time. elapsed_ms(phase) is time from t=0 (headline latencies); duration_ms/spawn_to_ms are phase-to-phase spans.
key_types.DemoReport: report.rs: the demo evidence artifact (class='warm_http_demo', schema warm-http-demo.v1.json). Carries host_metadata, pinned workload, cold_first_call_ms, warm_p50/p95/p99_ms, full warm Distribution, warmup_count, request/restore trials+failures, cold_phases (ColdPhaseDurations), cleanup (CleanupEvidence), blocked_reason/detail. No `pass` field anywhere; blocked reports carry nulls + a recorded reason.
